confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Reykjavik prices, carried forward to the July 2026 peak season; no live booking pages or listings were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is least certain because peak-July rates vary widely by property and booking timing, so hostel and hotel anchors are broad ranges. Beer assumes a roughly half-litre local draft in a restaurant. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the draft beer anchor, using the local price relationship, because direct recall is weaker. USD values assume the Icelandic krona stays near recent 2026 levels; a materially different rate would move all anchors. The FX observation came from search summaries of rba.gov.au pages, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Used high-cost Nordic capitals such as Oslo, Copenhagen and Stockholm as a regional reference for restaurant and drink levels, with an allowance for Iceland's high alcohol taxes and peak-July accommodation demand. Based on general knowledge, not live listings.
